'''Ciphas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He, [[Heirad]], and [[Kel'sara]] were part of the forces that accompanied [[Kephess]] to [[Asation]], and the trio fell in battle while guarding the path to the [[Grand Hypergate]] through the [[Quadrilateral Forum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ciphas, along with Heirad and Kel'sara, appear collectively as the second boss in "Terror From Beyond," an Operation in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
